summary: Settings → Providers and models: the intent interpreter (primary + one technical fallback), public web synthesis and voice memo transcription become settable flows of the existing R6 write path (/agent/config: CAS on the Gateway config revision, included-cost allowlist, receipt v2, replay, revert, inherit). Each executor reads its own plugin-config key with fallback to its current constant; only the executor's qualified references are admitted. /providers gains a twelfth role, intent_interpreter, and shows engineering/immune chains from the canonical model_policy routing profiles instead of the engineering-lite agent default (the governor passes --model on every call). Read-only flows carry a precise editableReason.
reason: Amine 30/10: every AI usage must be settable from the app, the interpreter included (primary and fallback), and the models fixed in code (web search, voice memos) through a config key with fallback to the current constant. Mapping done on the S24 the same day (openclaw.json, pinned model_policy.json, plugin LLM policy, brain-only mode).

limitations: Full canonical CI on the final GitHub head remains required.
The interpreter setting takes effect once the twin playbooks PR (governor reader) is activated; deploy this core first (its port admits Luna).

Web synthesis and memo transcription admit exactly one qualified model today (Gemini free): the setting is in place, a second model needs its own qualification (web synthesis contract in gemini-request.py, public_web.py and runWeb.ts; memo transcription receipt) before it can be offered. Their executors keep their constant until then.

memory_search, realtime_voice, spoken_voice, immune_system and engineering_learning stay read-only: embedding change pauses vector search until reindex; the Live voice model is a qualified protocol constant (talk.realtime is not read by Samantha's voice); app read-aloud uses the phone's TTS; immune/engineering chains belong to the pinned model_policy.json.
S24 30/10: SAMANTHA_BRAIN_ONLY=1, so the production interpreter serves the native Pulse rooms only.
The app (android/samantha, line feature/samantha-ux-c11-20261009) hardcodes the three editable flows and the eleven ids: a twin app PR is needed to edit the new flows and show intent_interpreter.
rollback: Inherit (or revert) each executor flow from the app first, so no executor key remains in openclaw.json, then revert this PR and redeploy the core. A remaining key would be refused by the previous plugin config schema.
